machine.binding: machine-name.txt at the root, gitignored - this machine's own name for itself, one of those rsc/machine/machines.csv declares; without it capture cannot address the store and the Signature cannot name the machine
machine.environment: a variable exported under a name the repository no longer reads - YOGA_NO_SEND, YOGA_JOBS, YOGA_GATE_TIMINGS; the names are CORPUS_YOGA_<name>, and VENV is CORPUS_YOGA_VENV

tools.jq: every pipeline's json work runs through it
tools.python3: the one python3 that survives (issues/478) - it mints the venv, and everything else runs the venv's python
tools.pyright: corpus-yoga test run type-checks src/ against pyrightconfig.json with it
tools.shellcheck: corpus-yoga test run lints every src/**/*.sh with it
tools.docker: corpus-yoga test run reproduces the mcp snapshot through upstream's generator (mcp.reproducible); corpus-yoga mcp reproduce runs it alone
tools.antlr4 and java: corpus-yoga grammar sync generates the parsers with them, and corpus-yoga test run holds the parsers current (grammar.parser_current)

explanation.venv: the one interpreter every .py target runs in; CORPUS_YOGA_VENV= names another
explanation.python requirements: what corpus-yoga pipeline run needs, by its manifest src/requirements.txt
explanation.git: the tool, and the identity a commit requires
explanation.pipeline inputs: what each pipeline holds in shared storage, a count per pipeline, provider and kind of unit, under data/input/<provider>/...; this repo ships no data, a room supplies its own, and the capturing noun's verb stages more - corpus-yoga browser capture, agent capture, export capture

live stores.the live store: the directory the provider's harness writes its sessions to - ~/.claude/projects, ~/.gemini/antigravity - outside the repository, harness-owned, and expiring at the provider's will; corpus-yoga agent capture --provider <provider> copies it into the room's stage
live stores.the mount: ext/mnt/<provider>/code/machine-transport/<machine>, a link to the live store at the address its units have under tmp/stage/input and data/input, through which the census and the capture read it; corpus-yoga agent mount makes it, pointing where the provider registry says

explanation.deploy: ext/mnt/site is a link to a clone of the site repository, which corpus-yoga site publish pushes to; optional - only a deploying machine has it, and ln -s <site-repo-clone> ext/mnt/site makes it (rsc/site/README.md)
explanation.migration: corpus-yoga migration - the moves a rename owes this machine's local roots, each a guarded script under rsc/migration run once; its sync takes the pending steps

optional modes.browser capture: possible on macOS with osascript, Safari logged in to claude.ai and gemini.google.com; unavailable elsewhere, the other pipelines unaffected
optional modes.Safari's Allow JavaScript from Apple Eve: capture needs it on; disabled, capture fails fast naming it - Safari's Settings, Advanced, Show features for web developers, then Settings, Developer; on some Safari versions it cannot be read without changing it, and the row says so
optional modes.indexing capture: possible with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set; only the paid concept and category capture needs it

explanation.now: the room's standing, folded once from the standing each noun says under its own now key - store, forge, cache, logs, server and site, each read once, together - what the room's state allows the reader to do now, by command, its verb and the things it acts on with how many; a noun that could not be read, or whose standing is a sentence other than none, stands under its command; corpus-yoga status says it last, and the launcher's reply after every act says the same fold (issues/949)
